text_block_list.text: I was helping out as staff at a fan event featuring Eishin Flash and Smart Falcon, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What! The music will not play...? But there is still one song remaining on the program...

text_block_list.name: Audio Staff
text_block_list.text: We're rushing to swap the equipment right now, but it's going to take a bit longer...
choice_data_list: Can you two somehow buy some time on stage?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yep, leave it to me to fill in with some talk! An Umadol can overcome any pinch with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall also make every effort possible. Falcon-san, please lead the way...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —And so, when I was a kid, I danced in front of the TV every single day pretending to be an idol~! Can I try doing it right now? What do you think~?

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: We wanna seeee it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you, everyone☆ Well then—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sparkle, sparkle~♪ Heart-fluttering~ premonition of love~~♪

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: So cuteeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible... The cheers won't stop.
As expected of Falcon-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what about you, Flash-san?
Did you mimic singers when you were little?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (! Alright, I should follow Falcon-san's lead here...!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not singing impressions, but—
playing the role of a knight in my elementary school play left quite an impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
O my beautiful princess! Upon my knightly honor,
I swear my eternal loyalty to thee!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: !? Kyaaaaaaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing...! The sheer volume of the cheers is buzzing against my eardrums...
...I see, so this is the sensation Falcon-san strives for...!)

The equipment was finally restored, and the final song began.
With the crowd already warmed up by their talk, the venue's excitement reached its peak right from the start!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let Falco hear your voices~~!
Love love, absolutely love lovely Falco!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Love love, absolutely love lovely Falco!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone! For me as well!
Liebe! Liebe! Lieblich!
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Liebe! Liebe! Lieblich!
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Come, give us even more cheers!!
Let us all get excited together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Amaze-amaziiing!!
That was way more hype than usual~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Flash-san! I knew she'd match my energy!
She even got everyone to do call-and-response at the end...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu... No, it is all thanks to you, Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: By modeling my behavior after yours and experiencing the crowd's passionate heat firsthand—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: your passion as an Umadol took root within my own heart.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
! Flash-san...!
Uwaaaah... Big hugggg~~☆

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Encore! Encore!
The audience's lingering excitement showed no signs of cooling down. How should they respond to those feelings?
choice_data_list: Let's hype them up with some more talk!
Let's hype them up with a special talent!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Talk... is it? Understood.
I will do my best.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And then! Flash-san went, "Taking humidity into account, let us stir it seven more rotations!" looking so happy while stirring her natto—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wha—Falcon-san!?
You didn't need to share that much detail...!
Thanks to the amusing anecdote about Eishin Flash, the venue was fired up once again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A special talent, is it...? Understood, I shall give it a try. Now then—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In response to your encore—
I shall demonstrate soccer juggling.

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Incredible! She's insanely good!
Bravo!!
Eishin Flash demonstrated an unexpected special talent, getting the crowd massively hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In response to your encore—
I shall demonstrate soccer juggling. Here goes—

text_block_list.name: Audience Member
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh... She's surprisingly good at that...!
Eishin Flash demonstrated a subtle talent, bringing a moderate amount of excitement to the venue.
